ExpressRoute Peering Location (MSEE Pair) & FastPath Scope
FastPath: Hub VNet IPv4 only (no UDR/Peering)

Watch MPLS hairpinning in multi-region DR
FastPath: Peering/IPv6 + IPv4 UDR & PL (Lim GA)
Decision Rule: Use Provider Circuits for <=10 Gbps rapid onboarding; choose ExpressRoute Direct for MACsec, >=40 Gbps circuits, port slicing, or Spoke/UDR/IPv6 FastPath.
